seoTitle: Customize Your TradingView Chart for a Cleaner Setup
metaDescription: Learn how to access TradingView's chart settings to customize candlesticks, status line, scales, background, and trading display options.
intro: A well-organized TradingView chart reduces distractions and can make your analysis more effective. This guide covers opening the chart settings menu and adjusting the key sections, from candlestick appearance to background color and trading display, so your setup fits your strategy.

steps.heading: Open chart settings
steps.body: Access settings using the cog wheel icon on your chart, or right-click the chart and choose settings from the menu.

steps.heading: Adjust the symbol tab
steps.body: Customize the appearance of candlesticks, bars, or lines to make price action more or less prominent based on your preference.

steps.heading: Configure the status line
steps.body: Control which information displays on your chart, such as last price, high, and low, showing or hiding fields to fit your strategy.

steps.heading: Simplify scales and lines
steps.body: Adjust the appearance of axes and grid lines so you can focus on price movement instead of visual clutter.

steps.heading: Set the canvas and background
steps.body: Change the chart's background and color theme to reduce eye strain during longer analysis sessions.

steps.heading: Review trading and alerts tabs
steps.body: If you use paper or live trading, configure how orders and positions display, and set up the alerts and events tabs for important notifications.

faq.question: Where do I find chart settings on TradingView?
faq.answer: You can access settings using the cog wheel icon on your chart or by right-clicking the chart and selecting settings.

faq.question: Can I change how candlesticks look?
faq.answer: Yes, the symbol tab in chart settings lets you customize candlestick, bar, or line appearance.

faq.question: Why would I simplify the scales and grid lines?
faq.answer: Reducing visual clutter in the scales and lines section helps you focus more directly on price movement.

faq.question: Can I customize the chart background color?
faq.answer: Yes, the canvas section lets you adjust the background and overall color theme of your chart.

faq.question: Does this affect paper or live trading display?
faq.answer: Yes, the trading tab lets you configure how orders and positions appear if you're using paper or live trading through TradingView.
